title: 13th Sitting of Third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/13/3/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 7/3/2026 to 9/3/2026).
Preliminary debate on a resolution to find out MPs' views on the removal of three Supreme Court justices from office over allegations without any basis, submitted by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the bill to amend the Education Act (Law No. 24/2020), submitted on behalf of the government by Huraa MP Dr. Anara Naeem.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: This sitting was set to debate a resolution on the removal of three Supreme Court justices and continue debating changes to the Education Act.
